title: CPI-M, Congress joined hands after losing public support, alleges Tripura CM

ai.summary: Tripura Chief Minister Manik Saha accused CPI-M and Congress of joining hands after losing public support to stage sit-in demonstrations and political theatrics, claiming the previous Left Front government caused violence and deaths.

facts.claim: CPI-M and Congress joined hands after losing public support
facts.quote: CPI-M and Congress, having lost public support, had joined hands for political survival and were now resorting to sit-in demonstrations and political theatrics.

facts.claim: Previous Left Front government caused violence and deaths
facts.quote: We all know what happened during their (CPI-M government’s) so-called golden era. Many people were killed in Khowai town during that period. As many as 69 people were killed in South Tripura district alone,
